en: Then the sun came out, and someone forgot their umbrella.
zh: 后来太阳出来了，有人把伞忘在了车上。

en: It rode the line all day. Nobody needs an umbrella in the sun.
zh: 它坐着车跑了一整天。晴天里，谁也不需要伞。

en: At the end of the line, it joined 312 others.
zh: 到了终点站，它和另外 312 把伞待在了一起。

en: Then, at rush hour, the storm came back.
zh: 后来，晚高峰，暴雨又来了。
车场打开了所有的货架。

en: 313 umbrellas went back out into the rain.
Lost on a sunny day. Found on a rainy one.
zh: 晴天里丢的，雨天里找到了用处。
